name: slopify
description: Outcome-driven engineering and research through explicitly invoked workflows: shape turns an idea into a story, bug, or spike card from the plugin's templates and files it; deliver-story, deliver-trivial, deliver-bugfix, and deliver-spike take a story, a small change, a bug, or a question to a reviewed PR, a question's PR adding a findings document; validate runs a project's validation on a branch or PR; research answers a question with new sources in the project library, delivered as a PR. Skills: ask answers from the library, lint checks and repairs it, bootstrap sets up the board and forge declarations and the library. Agents: single-task scouts (gather), lenses (validate), and advisors (judge); designer, coder, writer-spec, writer-docs, writer-findings, and writer-card (produce); judge (rules on findings); qa and validator (validate code); pusher (the only board and forge operator); watcher (waits for reviews); auditor (validates setup); and the library agents.
